title.en: An Act Converting the Extension Office of the Land Transportation Office in the Municipality of Naic, Province of Cavite, Into a Regular District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Extension Office of the Land Transportation Office in the Municipality of Naic, Province of Cavite, Into a Regular District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Văn phòng mở rộng Land Transportation Office thành Văn phòng Khu vực Chính quy tại Đô thị Naic, Tỉnh Cavite, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะสำนักงานขยาย Land Transportation Office เป็น สำนักงานเขตปกติ ในเทศบาล Naic จังหวัด Cavite และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Kantor Perluasan Land Transportation Office menjadi Kantor Distrik Reguler di Kotamadya Naic, Provinsi Cavite, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Pejabat Lanjutan Land Transportation Office kepada Pejabat Daerah Biasa di Perbandaran Naic, Wilayah Cavite, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: The extension office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) located in the Municipality of Naic, Province of Cavite, is hereby converted into a regular district office.

The Secretary of the Department of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the LTO District Office in the Municipality of Naic, Province of Cavite, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the LTO Extension Office in the Municipality of Naic. Thereafter, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
